name: CONSENT_LINKED_SURG_PROCS
description: Contains data pertaining to the surgical procedures the consent document covers.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the document record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: CONSENT_PROC_ID
columns.description: The procedures attached to consent from the case, networked to the procedures list (ORP).

columns.name: CONSENT_PROC_ID_PROC_NAME
columns.description: The name of the surgical procedure record.

columns.name: CONSENT_PROC_LATERALITY_LRB_C_NAME
columns.description: The procedure lateralities attached to consent from the case.

columns.name: CONSENT_PROC_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: The procedure descriptions attached to consent from the case.

columns.name: CONSENT_PROC_CASE_ID
columns.description: The surgical case that the surgical procedure linked to this consent is on.

columns.name: CONSENT_PROC_PANEL
columns.description: The panel to which this procedure on consent belongs.
